ALLOCATES.label: allocates
ALLOCATES.purpose: Connects a concrete JCL DD allocation to the dataset it resolves at runtime.

ASSIGNED_TO.label: assigned to
ASSIGNED_TO.purpose: Connects a COBOL SELECT file handle to the external DD name used by JCL.

BINDS.label: binds
BINDS.purpose: Connects a JCL allocation statement to the DD name exposed to a program step.

CALLS.label: calls
CALLS.purpose: Represents an observed COBOL control-flow transfer from a caller to a program or paragraph.

CONTAINS.label: contains
CONTAINS.purpose: Expresses a deterministic structural parent-child relationship in source or job definitions.

DECLARES.label: declares
DECLARES.purpose: Records that a source artifact or program defines the connected entity.

DEPENDS_ON.label: depends on
DEPENDS_ON.purpose: Represents a modern source-level dependency between Java types.

DERIVED_FROM.label: derived from
DERIVED_FROM.purpose: States that a curated business rule is supported by specific legacy source evidence.

EXECUTES.label: executes
EXECUTES.purpose: Connects a JCL step to the program or utility named on its EXEC statement.

HAS_DD.label: has DD
HAS_DD.purpose: Associates a JCL step with one of its DD allocation statements.

HAS_RULE.label: has rule
HAS_RULE.purpose: Associates a modernization workload with a curated behavior claim in its semantic scope.

HAS_SCENARIO.label: has scenario
HAS_SCENARIO.purpose: Associates a workload with a public or verifier-private behavior scenario.

IMPLEMENTED_BY.label: implemented by
IMPLEMENTED_BY.purpose: Maps a curated business rule to the modern Java method intended to implement it.

LEGACY_ENTRYPOINT.label: legacy entry point
LEGACY_ENTRYPOINT.purpose: Identifies the authoritative legacy program at the boundary of a modernization workload.

MODERN_ENTRYPOINT.label: modern entry point
MODERN_ENTRYPOINT.purpose: Identifies a modern application or batch configuration type that starts the replacement workload.

READS.label: reads
READS.purpose: Records that a COBOL paragraph consumes records through the connected file handle.

READS_WRITES.label: reads and writes
READS_WRITES.purpose: Records that a COBOL paragraph uses the connected file handle for both input and update operations.

SCHEDULED_BY.label: scheduled by
SCHEDULED_BY.purpose: Maps a modernization workload to the legacy JCL job that schedules its execution.

USES_COPYBOOK.label: uses copybook
USES_COPYBOOK.purpose: Records that a COBOL program imports and depends on the connected copybook.

VERIFIED_BY.label: verified by
VERIFIED_BY.purpose: Connects a business-rule claim to the test or scenario that supplies independent behavioral evidence.

WRITES.label: writes
WRITES.purpose: Records that a COBOL paragraph creates or updates records through the connected file handle.

ACCESSES.direction: CICS command to logical file resource
ACCESSES.label: accesses
ACCESSES.purpose: Records the logical CICS file or dataset named by an EXEC CICS data command.

BACKED_BY.direction: CICS file resource to VSAM catalog object
BACKED_BY.label: backed by
BACKED_BY.purpose: Resolves a CICS FILE definition to its cataloged VSAM cluster or path.

HAS_COMPONENT.direction: VSAM cluster to data or index component
HAS_COMPONENT.label: has component
HAS_COMPONENT.purpose: Connects an IDCAMS cluster definition to its named data and index components.

HAS_FIELD.label: has field
HAS_FIELD.purpose: Connects a BMS map to a screen field with its position, length, and attributes.

HAS_MAP.label: has map
HAS_MAP.purpose: Connects a compiled BMS mapset to the maps it contains.

ISSUES.direction: COBOL scope to EXEC CICS command
ISSUES.label: issues
ISSUES.purpose: Records the exact program or paragraph scope that issues an EXEC CICS command.

RESOLVES_TO.direction: logical or catalog name to implementation
RESOLVES_TO.label: resolves to
RESOLVES_TO.purpose: Resolves a configured CICS or JCL identity to the source program or VSAM object it represents.

STARTS_PROGRAM.label: starts program
STARTS_PROGRAM.purpose: Records the PROGRAM resource selected by a CICS transaction definition.

TARGETS.direction: VSAM index or path to its target
TARGETS.label: targets
TARGETS.purpose: Connects VSAM paths and alternate indexes to the catalog objects they address.

USES_MAP.direction: EXEC CICS command to BMS map
USES_MAP.label: uses map
USES_MAP.purpose: Records the BMS map named by an EXEC CICS SEND or RECEIVE command.

USES_MAPSET.direction: EXEC CICS command to BMS mapset
USES_MAPSET.label: uses mapset
USES_MAPSET.purpose: Records the BMS mapset named by an EXEC CICS SEND or RECEIVE command.

BRANCHES_TO.label: branches to
BRANCHES_TO.purpose: Records a statically resolved HLASM branch target without claiming runtime reachability.

HAS_DATASET_GROUP.label: has dataset group
HAS_DATASET_GROUP.purpose: Connects an IMS DBD to a DATASET macro and its DD, record, or access attributes.

INDEXES.direction: IMS logical child to indexed segment
INDEXES.label: indexes
INDEXES.purpose: Represents an IMS LCHILD relationship between index and target database segments.

DESCRIBES.label: describes
DESCRIBES.purpose: Connects a Db2 DCL host-variable contract to the table it describes.

HAS_COLUMN.label: has column
HAS_COLUMN.purpose: Connects a Db2 table to a deterministically parsed column.

HAS_CONSTRAINT.label: has constraint
HAS_CONSTRAINT.purpose: Connects a Db2 table to a parsed key or integrity constraint.

ISSUES_SQL.label: issues SQL
ISSUES_SQL.purpose: Records the COBOL scope that issues an embedded SQL statement.

REFERENCES_COLUMN.label: references column
REFERENCES_COLUMN.purpose: Connects embedded SQL to the exact Db2 columns it reads or changes.

WRITES_TABLE.label: writes table
WRITES_TABLE.purpose: Records a statically observed insert, update, or delete against a table.

PARENT_OF.direction: IMS parent segment to child segment
PARENT_OF.label: parent of
PARENT_OF.purpose: Records the physical or logical IMS hierarchy declared by a SEGM macro.

SENSITIVE_TO.label: sensitive to
SENSITIVE_TO.purpose: Connects an IMS PCB view to each SENSEG exposed to the application.

USES_DBD.label: uses DBD
USES_DBD.purpose: Resolves a PCB DBDNAME to the IMS database definition it authorizes.

USES_DSECT.label: uses DSECT
USES_DSECT.purpose: Records a HLASM COPY dependency on a symbolic storage layout.

USES_MACRO.label: uses macro
USES_MACRO.purpose: Records an observed HLASM macro invocation from a program.

USES_PSB.label: uses PSB
USES_PSB.purpose: Binds a BMP or DLI application to the PSB named by its execution parameters.
